polls.description: Multiple major security incidents including Pentagon Claude deployment breach and Anthropic developer tool compromise expose critical AI security vulnerabilities.
polls.question: Who bears more responsibility for these AI security breaches?

cluster_stories.title: A Claude agent ran inside a Pentagon network for two months, WIRED reports
cluster_stories.summary: An Accenture contractor connected a sensitive Pentagon system to their personal Claude Code account. The AI agent then ran on a Defense Department network for two months, Vittoria Elliott reported for WIRED on Thursday 29 October, citing sources. The agent appears to have sent login credentials and a network map to a high-risk website, the […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: PENTAGON DEPLOYS CLAUDE AGENT... SECURITY BREACH ROCKS DOD

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic hacked to deliver remote access trojan to Claude developer laptops
cluster_stories.summary: Article URL: https://doublepulsar.com/anthropic-hacked-to-deliver-remote-access-trojan-to-claude-developer-laptops-worldwide-1148a92baae2?postPublishedType=initial Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50307475 Points: 4 # Comments: 2

cluster_stories.title: The $6.3 Billion Binance Hack Was Pulled Off in Just 20 Minutes
cluster_stories.summary: Multiple crypto-tracing firms say notorious North Korean hackers TraderTraitor may be behind the largest digital heist in history—with billions of crypto likely gone for good.

cluster_stories.title: North Korean hackers used AI in crypto heists record $6bn Binance theft
cluster_stories.summary: North Korean hackers may be using AI to plan and carry out cryptocurrency thefts, according to security experts cited in a Bloomberg report published on Monday. They point to the growing complexity and precision of recent attacks, including last week’s record theft from Binance. The use of AI has not been confirmed, and Bloomberg presents […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: NORTH KOREA USING AI FOR $6BN BINANCE CRYPTO HEIST

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic VS code extension on Cursor backdoored for nearly 12 hours
cluster_stories.summary: It's still unknown how attackers got access to Anthropic's verified Cursor account.
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC CURSOR EXTENSION BACKDOORED for 12 Hours

cluster_stories.title: Spooky New Infostealer Malware Uses AI to ‘Autodox’ Victims
cluster_stories.summary: Named “Volta-Autodoxer,” the recently uncovered malware uses AI tools to collect troves of data about victims, from login credentials and credit card numbers to Discord sessions and UberEats receipts.
cluster_stories.headline: NEW AI-POWERED MALWARE 'AUTODOXES' VICTIMS

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic denies breach as tampered Claude Code extension hits Cursor users
cluster_stories.summary: A tampered copy of Anthropic’s Claude Code extension sat in Cursor’s extension marketplace for about 11 hours on Thursday 29 October. It reached up to 5,000 users. The malicious versions tried to plant an SSH backdoor on developers’ machines, Cursor said in a security notice. Anthropic says nobody breached its own systems. A security firm […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: MALICIOUS CLAUDE EXTENSION HITS 5,000 CURSOR USERS

cluster_stories.title: North Korean hackers linked to crypto thefts among world's best, experts say
cluster_stories.summary: Blockchain investigation firms TRM Labs and Chainalysis attribute the heist to a North Korean hacking group known as "TraderTraitor," a name used in a 2022 joint warning from the FBI, CISA and US Treasury that described how hackers used malicious software and other tricks to target software developers and IT staff at cryptocurrency companies.

cluster_stories.title: Binance Hack Shows Power of Suspected North Korean Hackers
cluster_stories.summary: The record-setting $6.3 billion hack of Binance, the world’s biggest cryptocurrency exchange, has been blamed on alleged North Korean hackers, who have become infamous for preying on the digital-asset industry.

polls.description: OpenAI's dramatic $10B reduction in fundraising target signals potential AI investment bubble concerns and market cooling.
polls.question: Is OpenAI's $10B funding cut a smart correction or a warning sign?

cluster_stories.title: AI boom hits a wall on Wall Street as OpenAI cuts fundraising target while Meta gets a credit warning over its cash flow, spending and monetization
cluster_stories.summary: S&P Global cut its outlook on Meta to "negative" from "stable" late Friday.
cluster_stories.headline: AI BOOM HITS WALL: OpenAI Cuts Fundraising... Meta Gets Credit Warning

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI reportedly lowers funding target for new round
cluster_stories.summary: OpenAI’s latest funding round doesn't seem to be living up to expectations.
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI LOWERS FUNDING TARGET... Fundraising Round Disappoints

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI cuts its funding round target to $20bn, FT reports
cluster_stories.summary: OpenAI has cut the target for its latest funding round by $10bn, to about $20bn. The Financial Times reported the cut on Friday 30 October, citing people with knowledge of the matter. Some investors reduced their commitments as AI stocks sold off, according to the report. The round values OpenAI at $1.25tn. The company had […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI SLASHES FUNDING TARGET BY $10BN

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI slashes funding target by $10bn as tech anxieties mount
cluster_stories.summary: ChatGPT maker is now seeking about $20bn at a $1.25tn valuation as it tempers its ambitions
cluster_stories.headline: BREAKING: OpenAI Slashes Funding Target $10B to $20B

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI Funding Target Cut by $10 Billion as AI Slumps, FT Says
cluster_stories.summary: OpenAI has cut its fundraising target by $10 billion as an AI stock selloff and rival Anthropic PBC’s impending public listing complicate its efforts to secure investor commitments, the Financial Times reported.
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI SLASHES FUNDING TARGET BY $10B... AI Bubble Fears Mount

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI cuts funding target by $10 billion: FT
cluster_stories.summary: AI startup OpenAI has slashed the target for its latest funding round by $10 billion and is now seeking to raise $20 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation, the Financial Times
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI CUTS FUNDING BY $10B as AI Market Wobbles

cluster_stories.title: Tech Stocks Tumble as Amazon Adds to AI Spending Fears
cluster_stories.summary: Tech stocks plunged on Friday for the second day in a row as fears around AI spending collide with disappointing earnings in big tech’s core businesses.
cluster_stories.headline: TECH STOCKS CRASH AS AI SPENDING FEARS MOUNT

cluster_stories.title: Big Tech sheds nearly $900bn in rout over soaring AI spending
cluster_stories.summary: Cash burn at Google, Amazon and Meta leads Wall Street to question price of AI boom
cluster_stories.headline: BIG TECH LOSES $900BN ON AI SPENDING FEARS
